title: Haywood Henry, Dud Bascomb and the band as brothers
summary: Hawkins recalls Haywood as a track star, and Goines mentions studio work with Haywood and Dud.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

Yes. The other members of the band like Haywood, and Dud.
You know, going back to the sports, Haywood was a terrific track star.
Well, Haywood, I don't know about teaching, but he was terrific there in school because they wanted him to stay on their track team.
They were, I don't know what to say about the rest of them because all of them was in their classes. But, the teaching part, I don't know what they had to do beside that.
We were all just like brothers, you know?
